name: Debug CI Failure
summary: Trace a failing CI job to the earliest actionable divergence and a minimal discriminating check.
description: Diagnose a failing CI job by correlating an exact run, logs, workflow revision, environment, and repository evidence before proposing a bounded remedy. Use when a check fails remotely, flakes, or differs from a local result.
refuses: It does not rerun, cancel, edit, disable, or approve CI workflows without separate authorization.
It does not expose secrets from logs or reproduce a failure by weakening permissions and safety controls.
It does not claim root cause from the last error line, a successful retry, or an untested correlation.
